title: Enablement Kit — Microsoft Entra: Hybrid Identity
author_notes: Enablement Kit. Distinct from the existing 'Hybrid Identity with AD & Entra Connect' IMPLEMENTATION product — this is the team-enablement/labs deliverable; cross-reference. PowerShell (Microsoft.Graph / Az) + KQL. Cross-references existing Entra solutions (ENTPIM/ENTPASSKEY/ENTZTCA/ENTIGA, Conditional Access Integration, Hybrid Identity, SAML App Factory, enterprise-app governance) rather than duplicating them (gap-only). Change scripts -WhatIf/report-only-first + break-glass; licensing (P1/P2/Governance/GSA/Verified ID) + preview flagged verify.
